title: Sunday Cupping Session
description: Join our head roaster for a guided cupping of four single-origin coffees from East Africa. Learn to identify tasting notes, evaluate body and acidity, and discover what makes each origin unique. Light pastries included.

title: Latte Art Throwdown
description: Think you can pour a rosetta? Bring your A-game to our monthly latte art competition. All skill levels welcome — our baristas will coach you through the basics before the showdown begins.

title: Mezcal & Agave Night
description: A deep dive into the world of agave spirits. Taste six mezcals from different regions of Oaxaca, learn about production methods, and discover why terroir matters as much in spirits as it does in wine.

title: Spring Menu Launch Party
description: Be the first to taste our new spring cocktail menu. Our bar team has been developing these recipes for months — eight new cocktails inspired by the farmers market. Passed bites included.

title: Orange Wine Flight Night
description: Explore the world of skin-contact whites with a curated flight of five orange wines from Georgia, Slovenia, and Italy. Our sommelier will walk you through the ancient winemaking tradition experiencing a modern revival.

title: Sourdough 101 Workshop
description: Start your sourdough journey with our head baker. You'll learn to create and maintain a starter, shape your first loaf, and understand the science of fermentation. Take home your own starter and a fresh loaf.

title: Croissant Masterclass
description: The ultimate lamination experience. Over three hours, you'll learn to make croissant dough from scratch, master the fold technique, and bake golden, flaky croissants. Take home a dozen.

title: Farm Visit: Hudson Valley
description: Join Chef Marcus on a morning trip to Stone & Thistle Farm in the Hudson Valley. Tour the grounds, meet the farmers, and enjoy a field lunch prepared with ingredients picked that morning.

title: Spring Harvest Dinner
description: A five-course prix fixe dinner celebrating the first harvest of spring. Each course is paired with natural wines selected by our sommelier. A celebration of what the season brings.

title: Coffee & Vinyl Morning
description: Our monthly Saturday morning listening session. Bring a record or pick from our collection. We'll brew a special single-origin while you enjoy the warmth of analog sound.
